qa_pairs.question: Hi I am Mike with Flat River Electric, Brian …….. I have been looking forward to meeting with you today. The office said some nice things about you.
qa_pairs.answer: Really, what did they say?

qa_pairs.question: Before we get started, I wanted to check and make sure there are no concerns with where my vehicle is parked.
qa_pairs.answer: No, it is perfect

qa_pairs.question: Great, Brian would you be opposed to me putting on my floor protectors and coming in?
qa_pairs.answer: No, not at all. Welcome in. OR Sure come in but you don’t have to put those on.

qa_pairs.question: So Brian, what are we hoping to accomplish today?
qa_pairs.answer: We are looking to add some recessed lighting.

qa_pairs.question: Okay, so this is something that we are just looking into and don't plan on doing anytime soon, correct?
qa_pairs.answer: No, we would like this done sooner than later but it depends on pricing.

qa_pairs.question: The star’s align and I am able to create a quality solution for you at a price that you felt was fair, what would happen then?
qa_pairs.answer: We would get it done then.

qa_pairs.question: Typically this kind of call takes approximately 60-90 minutes. If it is going to be much more or much less than that, does that work for you?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, I will be here all day.

qa_pairs.question: As I go through my process on your electrical system, if I notice anything that needs attention or something you and your family would really enjoy, would you like me to bring it to your attention or keep it to myself?
qa_pairs.answer: Sure, if there's something wrong please let me know.

qa_pairs.question: Is there anyone else that would like to be part of the conversation?
qa_pairs.answer: No, not at this moment OR My Wife would want to be.

qa_pairs.question: Brian, what makes you wanna do this project now? I mean, why not just keep it the way that it is?
qa_pairs.answer: Well, it's starting to get dark out earlier now, and this room really doesn’t have good lighting. We would really like to have better lighting in this room.

qa_pairs.question: There are hundreds of electricians in this area. What made you decide to use our company today?
qa_pairs.answer: We see your truck going down the road almost everyday and you were the first company that came to mind.

qa_pairs.question: Have you had an opportunity to check out our Google reviews yet?
qa_pairs.answer: No, I have not yet.

qa_pairs.question: Brian, have you ever had to hire another professional electrician before? (First time)
qa_pairs.answer: No

qa_pairs.question: What about a friend, family member, or a handyman that helps you out with projects like this?
qa_pairs.answer: My brother-in-law typically helps me with this kind of project but this is more than he can handle or he will not be back in the area for a couple of weeks.

qa_pairs.question: Are you sure you don’t want to just wait for him or let him try this for you?
qa_pairs.answer: No, No, No, this is a larger project than he can handle and I don’t want it to make things weird between him and myself so I just want to hire this out.

qa_pairs.question: Brian, have you ever had to hire another professional electrician before? (Second time)
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, we have.

qa_pairs.question: What was the experience like? Were they professional?
qa_pairs.answer: We were not impressed with them. They never finished the last project that we had them do and it was very hard to get a hold of them.

qa_pairs.question: Are you sure you don’t want to give them another try?
qa_pairs.answer: No, No, I don't want to go through that experience again.

qa_pairs.question: How are you different from other electricians?
qa_pairs.answer: How are you different from other electricians?

qa_pairs.question: Now, hypothetically speaking, if you were to choose one of these options today, which option would you be leaning towards?
qa_pairs.answer: I think it would be that Gold option, but I need to . . . . .

qa_pairs.question: What do you like most about that option?
qa_pairs.answer: I like that it takes care of what I called you out for but also it will provide protection to all my electronics in my home. I didn’t even know there was such an option available.

qa_pairs.question: I have all these materials in our building; how about we get a team out here next Wednesday and get that installed for you?
qa_pairs.answer: No, we are not ready right now.

qa_pairs.question: Alright before I go I just gotta ask, would you like me to get you on the schedule so we can get this done and save you some time?
qa_pairs.answer: No, we are looking to get 3 bids and you are the first.
